_comment: Sample OpenHands adapter settings, in the shape agents/openhands/validate.js reads.
OpenHands has no config file of its own: these values are what you pass to LLM(...)
as base_url + api_key + extra_headers -- see example/openhands_connect.py.
Copy, fill in real values, and keep your copy out of git (it holds a credential).
validate.js reads this file by default; TDAM_* env vars override it.
